title: Stewart White Demo
content: Stewart Whitedid a watercolor demo yesterday at thePlein Air Painting Conference and Expoin San Diego.I did this live portrait as he painted. I was working in rather dim light with the book in my lap, so I used fairly dense mixtures of color and strong contrasts.Stewart, who hails from Baltimore, is renowned as both an architectural illustrator and an outdoor painter.  He'll beleading a workshop to Granada, Spain this October, which promises inspiring instruction, delicious food, and unforgettable camaraderie.
